selected_evidence.requirement: Rootless Podman container and service named node-hello under nodeapp
selected_evidence.summary: The user service is active; Podman reports rootless=true with nodeapp-owned storage, and container node-hello is running with port 8080 published.

selected_evidence.requirement: Return exactly Hello, world! from / on TCP port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, direct requests to $NODE_IP:8080/ returned HTTP 200 with exactly 13 bytes; captured hex is 48656c6c6f2c20776f726c6421.
nodeapp uses /usr/sbin/nologin, has Linger=yes, node-hello.service belongs to default.target, and it restarted automatically after host reboot.
Port 8080 is listening on 0.0.0.0 and allowed in both runtime and permanent firewalld configuration, including after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery sequence
selected_evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID f9031a39-89d7-426a-ae19-a60bfdcd23e1 was captured; the native reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID bdfdf6f3-5b9f-432d-9bba-6f2af7d5d9b7 proves restart; final evidence shows full system, service, container, firewall, and HTTP recovery.
